caption: The drawing depicts a large, urn-shaped vase positioned centrally within a rectangular border. The vase is rendered in shades of gray, creating a monochrome, graphite or pencil appearance. The body of the vase features a raised-relief profile portrait of a man in the center, with his face in side view, and is flanked on each side by sculpted heads in three-dimensional relief attached near the upper shoulders of the vase. The lower section of the vase's body has a frieze encircling it, which shows a sequence of human figures standing and interacting, with some architectural or column-like details interspersed. The overall composition is clean and focused, with the vase positioned against a plain background and an evenly drawn rectangular border. The artist’s name, “John Viana,” is written in the bottom right corner outside the border. The color palette is exclusively in neutral, beige-to-gray tones, which enhances the detailed modeling and shading on the vase and the figures adorning its surface.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
